lines.trans: Viktor, I have a lot of work today.
What is the matter, dear Victoria?
My sister asked me to babysit Alisa.
And why with you and not with me?
Because you are always busy in the kitchen.
I want to spend time with my daughter myself.
Alisa, who do you want to stay with?
My daughter wants to stay with her dad.
Well, you decided everything yourselves.
I will buy her delicious sweet chocolate.
Remember, she is not allowed to eat chocolate.
Do not worry, Vika, I know everything.
Watch her attentively until the evening.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters
affectionate form of дочь; also used by older people to address a young woman
irregular feminine declension with stem дочер-
not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)
of a person: я занят = I'm busy
of a place: здесь занято = it's occupied

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
